title: Three Springs and One Short Peg
subtitle: 污染治理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 污染治理（人与自然·环境保护·污染与治理）
meta: 主题语境：污染治理（人与自然·环境保护·污染与治理）　|　核心词汇：ground　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ground 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the inspector ① tested the ground that no farmer on the plain would have described, and he said the testing was the whole of the spring. The ② ground, meaning the soil itself and not the field, ran three springs and stayed undescribed in the book; ground, he said, is the only thing on a plain that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of ground on that plain had the same short peg beside it, and the ④ ground at the far ditch, meaning the plot they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Ground, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the inspector said the describing is the part that fills three springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the ground was the whole of the matter, meaning the reason and not the soil. The ⑥ ground, meaning the reason and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; ground, he said, is either something you test or the only word that means both a soil and a reason. He said the reason is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ ground had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short peg. The ⑧ ground of the whole thing, the inspector wrote in November, was one plain and three springs of describing; ground, he said, is either the plot at the far ditch or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ ground I remember is the ground described in the report, which closed in 1988 and is still described as the quietest on the plain. ⑩ Ground, my mother said in 1990, is the only soil that improves by being described; all ground, she said, is a reason that has agreed to look like a soil. She said the reason was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 土地；地面（指平原上每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 土地；土壤（指那些泥土本身，与田地相对）
C. 固定搭配：test the ground 检测土地
D. n. 地块（指留给孩子们学着种的那块）
E. n. 土地（抽象总称，指一片平原的土地之事）
F. n. 土地（指报告里写到、被记录过的那些）
G. n. 理由；根据（grounds for the decision，指一件事里人人都问却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 依据（抽象总称，指人人都问却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: tested the ground that no farmer on the plain would have described
The ground, meaning the soil itself and not the field
Every kind of ground on that plain
the ground at the far ditch
the ground was the whole of the matter
the ground had become a line in a report
The ground of the whole thing

answers.why: test the ground 意为“检测土地”，1981 年那位检查员检测了平原上没有一位农夫肯描述的土地。
ground 意为“土地、土壤”，指那些泥土本身而不是田地，它经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被描述。
ground 意为“土地、地面”，指平原上每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一根矮矮的木桩。
ground 意为“地块”，指最远那条沟渠边留给孩子们学着种的那块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
ground 意为“理由、根据”，指一件事里人人都问却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个理由就是那件事的全部。
ground 意为“依据”，指人人都问却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片土地，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
ground 意为“土地”，指报告里写到、被记录过的那些，到 1986 年这些成了报告里的一行。
ground 意为“土地”，检查员十一月写道，整件事的土地之事是一片平原和三个春天的描述。
ground 意为“土地”，我记得的是报告里描述过的那些，1988 年查完了，至今仍被说成平原上最安静的一片。
ground 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，土地是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的土壤。
